name: Comet
description: Comet is Perplexity's Chromium-based AI browser with a built-in 'Comet Assistant' — an in-tab browsing agent that answers questions about the current page, summarizes content, and completes web tasks like shopping, travel, finance, and email drafting. Free for all Perplexity account holders since October 2, 2025.

writing-chat.summary: Comet Assistant provides conversational, context-aware help inside the browser — answering questions about open tabs, drafting and refining text (including email replies), and carrying out web tasks described in natural language.

subFeatures.name: In-Tab Assistant
subFeatures.description: Ask questions about the current page or open tabs and get cited answers without leaving the browser

subFeatures.name: Email Drafting
subFeatures.description: Draft and refine email replies directly in webmail; Max users can cc an Email Assistant on a thread for scheduling and drafts

limitations: Assistant is grounded in the browser context, not a general-purpose coding chatbot
Background/Email Assistants for autonomous drafting require the Max tier
Answer quality depends on the content of the open page

pricingTiers.details: Comet Assistant for in-tab Q&A and drafting (any Perplexity account)
Adds Email Assistant and Opus-class agent

versionHistory.changes: Comet AI browser made free for all Perplexity account holders worldwide

research.summary: Comet brings Perplexity's answer engine into the browser: it searches the web with cited sources, summarizes pages and articles, and answers follow-up questions about whatever you are reading.

subFeatures.name: Page Summarization
subFeatures.description: Summarize the current article, page, or video and ask follow-up questions with inline citations

subFeatures.name: In-Browser Search with Citations
subFeatures.description: Perplexity's cited answer engine is available directly in the browser for real-time research while you browse

subFeatures.name: Shopping, Travel and Finance Help
subFeatures.description: Comet Assistant helps compare products, plan travel, and review financial information across open tabs

limitations: Cannot access login-protected content without the user's authenticated session
Premium publisher content may require the optional Comet Plus add-on
Research quality depends on source availability and page structure

pricingTiers.details: Page summarization, cited in-browser search, shopping/travel/finance help
Optional add-on for premium publisher content

versionHistory.changes: Cited in-browser research available to all account holders

file-analysis.summary: Because Comet is a full browser, the Comet Assistant can read and reason over documents open in a tab (such as PDFs) and over content from connected Perplexity Spaces.

subFeatures.name: In-Browser Document Q&A
subFeatures.description: Ask questions about PDFs and documents opened in a browser tab, with answers drawn from the page content

limitations: Analysis is scoped to content accessible in the browser session
Cannot process video or audio files
Heavier file-analysis limits follow the user's Perplexity tier

pricingTiers.details: Q&A over documents open in the browser
Higher limits inherited from the Perplexity Max account

versionHistory.changes: In-browser document Q&A via Comet Assistant

document-creation.summary: Comet Assistant can draft prose in the browser — emails, summaries, and notes — and surfaces Perplexity's research outputs; full deliverable generation (PPTX, CSV, dashboards) runs through Perplexity Labs in the same account.

subFeatures.name: In-Browser Drafting
subFeatures.description: Generate and refine written content such as emails, summaries, and notes directly within the browser

subFeatures.name: Email Assistant
subFeatures.description: Cc the agent on an email thread to draft replies and handle scheduling

limitations: Rich deliverables (slides, spreadsheets, dashboards) are produced via Perplexity Labs, not the browser chrome itself
Email Assistant requires the Max tier
No standalone collaborative document editor

pricingTiers.details: In-browser drafting of emails, summaries, and notes
Email Assistant for autonomous drafting and scheduling

image-generation.summary: Comet itself is an AI browser and does not generate images. Image generation is available in the Perplexity app under the same account.

subFeatures.name: Not in Browser Chrome
subFeatures.description: Image generation is handled by the Perplexity app, not the Comet browser interface

limitations: No image generation in the Comet browser surface
Image creation requires the Perplexity web/app surface

pricingTiers.details: Image generation available via the Perplexity app, not Comet

versionHistory.changes: No image generation in the browser surface

prototyping.summary: Comet is a consumer AI browser, not a development environment. It does not provide code execution, live preview, or an IDE.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Comet focuses on browsing and web task assistance — it does not offer code prototyping or execution

limitations: No code execution or live preview
No IDE integration
Not designed for software development workflows

pricingTiers.details: No prototyping capabilities

versionHistory.changes: No prototyping capabilities in the browser

personalization.summary: Comet personalizes to the signed-in Perplexity account, inheriting profile preferences and cross-conversation Memory so the assistant adapts to the user's context across sessions.

subFeatures.name: Account Personalization
subFeatures.description: Comet uses the signed-in Perplexity account's profile and preferences to tailor assistant responses

subFeatures.name: Memory
subFeatures.description: Cross-conversation memory carried from the Perplexity account (upgraded to ~95% recall in February 2026)

limitations: Full cross-conversation Memory follows the user's Pro/Max entitlement
Personalization is tied to the signed-in Perplexity account

pricingTiers.details: Account profile personalization
Adds cross-conversation Memory

persistent-context.summary: Comet maintains context within the browser across open tabs and inherits the Perplexity account's Spaces and Memory, so research context persists across sessions.

subFeatures.name: Cross-Tab Context
subFeatures.description: The assistant reasons over multiple open tabs to maintain context within a browsing session

subFeatures.name: Account Memory and Spaces
subFeatures.description: Inherits Perplexity Memory and Spaces from the signed-in account for persistent, cross-session context

limitations: Spaces and full Memory follow the user's Pro/Max entitlement
Cross-tab context is bounded by the current browser session

pricingTiers.details: Cross-tab context within a session
Persistent Memory and Spaces from the Perplexity account

agents.summary: Comet's defining feature is its in-tab browsing agent. Comet Assistant takes actions across open tabs to complete web tasks, and Max adds Background Assistants (parallel/async agents) and an Email Assistant powered by an Opus-class model.

subFeatures.name: Comet Assistant (Browsing Agent)
subFeatures.description: In-tab agent that navigates pages, fills forms, and completes multi-step web tasks such as shopping, travel, and finance

subFeatures.name: Background Assistants
subFeatures.description: Parallel/async agents that work off a to-do list in the background

subFeatures.name: Email Assistant
subFeatures.description: Cc the agent on an email thread for scheduling and drafting

limitations: Background Assistants, Email Assistant, and the Opus-class agent require the Max tier
Agent actions are bounded by site permissions and anti-bot defenses
Cannot perform desktop automation outside the browser

pricingTiers.details: Comet Assistant in-tab browsing agent for web tasks
Background Assistants, Email Assistant, Opus-class agent, early feature access

versionHistory.changes: Max adds parallel background agents alongside the free Comet release
In-tab browsing agent made free for all account holders worldwide

connectors.summary: As a full browser, Comet works across any website with the user's signed-in sessions, and inherits the Perplexity account's connectors (Gmail, Calendar, Notion, GitHub on Pro; more on Enterprise).

subFeatures.name: Authenticated Web Access
subFeatures.description: Operates within the user's own browser sessions, so the assistant can act on sites where the user is already signed in

subFeatures.name: Perplexity Connectors
subFeatures.description: Inherits Spaces connectors from the account — Gmail, Calendar, Notion, GitHub (Pro) and Outlook, Slack, Drive, and more (Enterprise)

limitations: Third-party data connectors require a Pro subscription or higher
Broader connector set requires Enterprise
Actions on a site are bounded by that site's terms and permissions

pricingTiers.details: Authenticated access to any site in the user's browser
Adds Gmail, Calendar, Notion, GitHub connectors
Adds Outlook, Slack, Drive, SharePoint, and more

versionHistory.changes: Browser-wide authenticated access plus account connectors

dictation.summary: Comet inherits Perplexity's voice capabilities — mobile voice dictation and Voice Mode — for hands-free queries to the in-tab assistant.

subFeatures.name: Voice Input
subFeatures.description: Dictate queries to Comet Assistant using Perplexity's mobile voice dictation

subFeatures.name: Voice Mode
subFeatures.description: Spoken back-and-forth with live cited results, inherited from Perplexity (iOS-first, Android/desktop rolling out)

limitations: Voice Mode is iOS-first; Android and desktop support is still rolling out
Voice input quality depends on the device microphone

pricingTiers.details: Voice dictation and Voice Mode inherited from the Perplexity account

versionHistory.changes: Voice input available via the Perplexity account
